The provided exception information indicates that `Helper.LBC_CURRENCY_FORMAT.format(cost)` and `Helper.FULL_LBC_CURRENCY_FORMAT.format(cost)` (called during message construction) may throw `ArithmeticException` (if the formatter uses `RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY` and rounding is needed). The `SecurityException` occurs in the asynchronous `onClick` handler; if uncaught, it crashes the app when the user clicks the positive button. Both exceptions should be caught to ensure robust behavior. A single try-catch cannot cover both scopes because they are in different execution contexts (synchronous vs. asynchronous). Thus, two separate try-catch blocks are needed: one wrapping the synchronous code (from fee retrieval to dialog display) to catch `ArithmeticException`, and another inside the `onClick` method to catch `SecurityException`. In the catch blocks, appropriate fallback actions (e.g., logging and returning early) should be taken to prevent crashes.
